Ooredoo prolonge jusqu’au 20 août 2026 l: Ooredoo is extending the deadline for submitting application files for the third edition of the "Rising Star" competition until August 20, 2026. This measure aims to offer more opportunities for Algerian students to participate in the event, whose central theme focuses on "Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Media in Algeria: Challenges and Perspectives."
Le jury, après examen des requêtes émana: The jury, after reviewing requests from participants, approved this extension to ensure broader participation. Candidates are invited to submit their work via a dedicated platform or by email, in accordance with the procedures defined by the internal regulations.
Un concours axé sur l’innovation et la c: A competition focused on student innovation and creativity
Le concours « Étoile montante » s’adress: The "Rising Star" competition is exclusively aimed at university students, who can compete individually. Each participant must submit a single piece of work, written in one of the four authorized languages: Arabic, Berber, French, or English. The chosen theme reflects contemporary issues related to technological transformations and their impact on the Algerian media landscape.
Pour faciliter l’accès aux informations,: To facilitate access to information, Ooredoo is providing a dedicated space on its official website, which lists the conditions of participation as well as links to the necessary resources. A specific page, titled "Rising Star," centralizes practical details, including the online application system.
Un engagement en faveur de l’excellence: A commitment to academic excellence and digital transformation
À travers ce concours, Ooredoo réaffirme: Through this competition, Ooredoo reaffirms its commitment to supporting academic excellence and encouraging innovation among young Algerian talents. The initiative is part of the operator's desire to contribute to building a media ecosystem adapted to current technological challenges, while offering participants a platform to express their vision and ideas.
La directrice des affaires institutionne: Ooredoo's Director of Corporate Affairs and Media Relations unit specify that this third edition is in continuity with the efforts deployed to support changes in the media sector, in alignment with the rapid advances of artificial intelligence.
